svg.title: How far children get, by how far their parents got
svg.desc: Austria, ages 25 to 44, surveys 2007 to 2022/23. Aligned proportional-area matrix: each cell is a 100 percent reference; the centered rectangle occupies the published percentage of that area. Parents increase left to right; children increase bottom to top. Both axes use the same four education categories. Percentages are within each parent group.

svg.text: Aligned rows and columns. Rectangle area = percentage of its cell; empty space completes the 100% reference.
Statistics Austria, Adult Education Survey 2007, 2011/12, 2016/17, 2022/23; Bildung in Zahlen 2018/19 and 2024/25, table 5.1_9a.
Parents' education is the higher of mother and father. Degree includes colleges; 2007 and 2011/12 group it slightly differently.
